It was replaced with a compact decorative three-step journey (set parameters, compare variants, check details) using an isolated home-journey-v1.css layer; the journey is hidden at <=820px so tablet/mobile remain intentionally simple. The existing form, search handoff and business logic were unchanged. PR #317 passed Security, standalone navigation/home handoff, PHP runtime, V2 validation/startup/branch-bundle, selected-tour, meal, trust and visual suites, plus the standalone 375/430/768/1024/1440 visual run. Squash merge 9eb6d3dceed32e5191fba65b2f6768a7c52f8298 deployed successfully in standalone run 33298269348; public pages, unchanged lead bridge and live search smoke were green. Production standalone visual run 33298337155 passed at all five required widths. Direct production review of desktop 1440 showed the new journey balanced against the hero copy and ready-state search form; mobile 375 remained clean and unchanged with no overflow. The visual guard also now blurs the CTA after focus verification so screenshots no longer preserve an artificial focus state. No Tourvisor, Metrika, analytics, lead, search/results/recovery or comparison contract changed.
